items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Cannonball Adderley in a question, but the interviewee (Monk Montgomery) does not respond to or reference Cannonball Adderley in the provided text.

ctx.x: And we'd been going to Ralph Gleason, was talking to Ralph about it, and I was telling Ralph I had this brother back home and he was so-and-so. And Ralph ended up putting all of this in an article, which I was very pleased about because he finally heard Wes. Like everybody else he was flabbergasted.
Was this about the same time that Cannonball Adderley told Orrin Keepnews...?

No, that was earlier. And Wes somehow wasn't able to attract any attention. He just didn't have any luck. In fact, he came to San Francisco and he had his trio, and he worked some around town. It was an organ trio, with Melvin
